[Long time existence improved] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0385 ↗ thm:chow-ii-appd-long-time-existence-closed 1. appD:D.6\group Ricci Flow Existence

Under the hypotheses of Theorem 1, if $T<\infty $, then \[ \lim _{t\nearrow T}\sup _{x\in \mathcal M}|\operatorname {Ric}(x,t)|=\infty . \]
